{{Quote|Order the Sun Guard to retrieve the miners we marooned in the Tingel Arm. Execute them and have their bodies dumped at the gates of Subtext Mining's corporate headquarters on Corellia.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
'''Subtext Mining Corporate Headquarters''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the headquarters for the company [[Subtext Mining]]. After marooning several Subtext mining executives in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] ordered for them to be killed and their bodies dumped in front of the Subtext Mining Headquarters for their role in selling a sabotaged [[M-2 mining probe droid]] to Plagueis and his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
